column1: # Single source of truth for the fail-closed repository identity guards.
# Every script that asserts "this checkout really is the repository I think it
# is" reads this table instead of hard-coding an owner. The guards exist to stop
# a workstation being bootstrapped, or private memory being published, from a
# look-alike fork. They are fail-closed by contract: an identity that is not
# listed here MUST be refused. Widening this table is the only supported way to
# accept a new owner, and every added row is a deliberate security decision.
# ai-devops accepts BOTH owners during the move to the popcre organization
# (issue #84, fix_to_gh_org.md). Existing clones keep the u2giants origin string
# and a fresh clone from the new URL records popcre; both must pass on the same
# commit, so there is no flag-day. The two PRIVATE siblings are deliberately NOT
# key<TAB>accepted canonical identity (host/owner/repo, no scheme, no .git)
